{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the sales data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check the status column again for any anomalies
print("Unique values in 'status':", sales_df['status'].unique())

# Verify that 'completed' is the only non-refunded status
print("Value counts for 'status':", sales_df['status'].value_counts().to_dict())

# Confirm that completed orders are not refunded
completed_not_refunded = sales_df[(sales_df['status'] == 'completed') & (sales_df['revenue'] > 0)]
num_completed_not_refunded = len(completed_not_refunded)

# Print the result
num_completed_not_refunded"}
